description: This file defines the SessionContent class, which manages session content items in the Notesnook project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and removing session content, and interacts with a SQL collection and database utilities.

classes.name: SessionContent
classes.description: Class for managing session content items, including adding, retrieving, and deleting content, with support for compression and encryption handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SQL collection for session content.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a session content item with provided content and metadata.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a session content item by ID, decompressing if necessary.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a session content item by ID.
